2608.25543.title: Goodput Maximization for Large Language Model Edge Inference: A Two-Phase Maskable PPO Approach
2608.25543.paper_summary: This paper presents a novel two-phase maskable proximal policy optimization (TP-MPPO) algorithm, which maximizes the system goodput counting request throughput with strict service level objective (SLO) compliance for large language model (LLM) inference services in wireless edge networks. In the first phase of TP-MPPO, we optimize the task offloading decisions by MPPO with action masking mechanism, effectively avoiding exploring invalid actions and reducing the action space. In the second phase, closed-form solutions are derived for uplink bandwidth allocation; a greedy algorithm is designed for downlink bandwidth allocation to provide immediate rewards for the MPPO in the next round. The two stages alternate till convergence. Simulation results demonstrate that TP-MPPO can improve the system reward by 33.3%--87.5% compared to its benchmarks and achieve the highest goodput.
2608.25543.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文提出了一種新穎的兩階段可屏蔽近端策略優化（TP-MPPO）算法，旨在最大化系統的良好吞吐量，並在無線邊緣網絡中對大型語言模型（LLM）推理服務遵循嚴格的服務水平目標（SLO）合規性。在TP-MPPO的第一階段，我們通過帶有行動屏蔽機制的MPPO來優化任務卸載決策，有效地避免探索無效行動並減少行動空間。在第二階段，導出了上行帶寬分配的封閉形式解；設計了一種貪婪算法用於下行帶寬分配，以便為下一輪的MPPO提供即時獎勵。這兩個階段交替進行，直到收斂。模擬結果表明，與基準相比，TP-MPPO可以提高系統獎勵33.3%至87.5%，並實現最高的良好吞吐量。
